done_when: While a builder's tests wait in the test line, the machine's agent line shows that place as free and another waiting item starts; when the builder's tests finish, it waits for an agent place again before its round goes on.
why: On busy days builders hold agent places while they wait for the test line, so other items cannot start even though those places sit idle (seen: 4 agent places held, 6 items waiting for tests, waits up to 3 hours).
